verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://lobehub.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit "When to use this site (AI agents)" section. Docs pages also serve agent-readable Markdown via .md routes ("AI markdown routing boundary"), and an agent-oriented skill.md exists for MCP publishing, alongside a machine-readable openapi.json. Missing for 10: the llms.txt content in the evidence is largely marketing copy rather than a full docs index, and there is no independent community corroboration of agents actually consuming these files.
